''There is an island off the coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.'' ''Meet, and fight.'' --[[Wu Shen]]
'''Fray Island''' is a small arid island located off the eastern shore of the [[Barrens]]. It is a training place for [[warrior]]s of all races and creeds and is led by [[Klannoc Macleod]]. A small sewer stretches the length of the island and players diving into it will be able to find several {{reputation|hostile}} [[fish]].
